question: The user asked whether the WNBA already has a plus-minus-style stat we should factor in or compete against. Does prior-season RAPM improve a strictly prior-games-only forecast, as a feature or as a reference component; does it beat D092's cold-start placeholder; and does raw per-game plus-minus add anything?
headline: RAPM is REAL BUT SMALL, and it is worth more as a REFERENCE COMPONENT than as a FEATURE. As a feature it never lifts a refit forecast past D094's tuned simple estimator. As a reference component its honest marginal contribution, after controlling for re-tuned shrinkage and against its own negative control, is about +0.1 to +0.4 percentage points of MAE skill pooled. The one place it clearly earns its keep is the COLD-START tier for VETERANS RETURNING (+1.2pp points, +1.5pp minutes over a no-RAPM control); for TRUE ROOKIES it does not exist and actively hurts. Raw per-game plus-minus is a CLEAN NULL everywhere.

step1_provenance.kit_status_note: screenkit.check_manifest only recognises 'row' and 'artifact'; it returns UNVERIFIABLE and usable_at_e0_e1=False for 'season' and says explicitly that this is NOT a pass. The manifest sha256 DOES match the bytes (169,266 bytes, 924411f3...). What discharges the check here is the VALUE-LEVEL verification below, not the manifest and not the coordinator's byte check.
step1_provenance.correction_to_brief: train_seasons is CUMULATIVE, not prior-season-only: emit 2022<-2021, 2023<-2021-2022, 2024<-2021-2023 (expanding window). `fit_through_season` is the LAST training season, which is what the manifest note names. Still STRICTLY PRIOR, and more data than the brief assumed, but not 'the prior season only'.
step1_provenance.hazard_found_here: lambda_chosen varies 50x across emit seasons (2022: 100000, 'fallback_max_grid', one training season, no inner validation, thin_history_caveat=True; 2023: 33000; 2024: 2000). Within-season SD of net_100 is 0.095 / 0.372 / 2.367 -- a 25x spread in the SCALE of the same column. net_100/orapm_100/drapm_100 are therefore used ONLY after within-emit-season standardisation; the primary continuous measure is a FIXED-lambda column.
step1_provenance.season_granularity_limitation: Season granularity satisfies the partition guard (D080) and, combined with the value-level strict-prior check, discharges the retrospective check. But RAPM is a SLOW-MOVING PRIOR: one value per player per season. It cannot capture within-season form, role change, injury return or a trade. It is a level, not a trajectory. This limitation travels with every result below.

step2_rapm_as_feature.verdict: NO. RAPM is DETECTABLE over a complete prior-only base but does not produce a forecast that beats the existing incumbent.
step2_rapm_as_feature.detection_note: Significant POOLED for all four targets; NOT significant on D081's decision stratum for any of them (p = 0.07 to 0.19). The negative control (whole-player-season relabelling) itself reproduces 40-50% of the pooled dR2, which is why the permutation null and not a t-test is what decides this.
step2_rapm_as_feature.decisive_point: Even WITH RAPM, the refit forecast is WORSE than D094's tuned simple estimator on 7 of 8 target x stratum cells. RAPM buys back part of the loss from refitting; it never gets the refit past the incumbent.
step2_rapm_as_feature.decomposition: The single largest component of the detectable signal is `has_rapm_f` -- the INDICATOR THAT A RAPM VALUE EXISTS AT ALL, not its value. For points-per-minute existence alone is +0.00200 of the block's +0.00310 (64%); for points +0.00089 of +0.00258 (35%). Dropping every net-RAPM column barely moves the block (pts +0.00230 of +0.00258) while keeping only the net columns collapses it (+0.00032). What RAPM mostly carries as a feature is a veteran/rookie indicator, not player quality.
step2_rapm_as_feature.walkforward_rank_hazard_found_and_fixed: A plain lstsq walk-forward fit scored MAE 9.30 on 2023 points where D094's estimator scores 4.19, because prevseason_*/lgexp_*/role_* are THE SAME COLUMN in the 2022 training fold. See NOTES.md; fixed by a structural-availability drop plus fold-internal ridge, applied identically to both arms.

step3_rapm_as_reference.verdict: YES, but far smaller than the raw comparison suggests, and MOST of the apparent gain is NOT RAPM.
step3_rapm_as_reference.best_variant: V3 -- keep the player's own prior-season mean where it exists, and fill the rows where it does not with a RAPM-derived value.
step3_rapm_as_reference.what_the_decomposition_shows: V3's headline (+1.04% points, +0.96% attempts, +1.33% minutes, +0.38% ppm over D094) is mostly NOT RAPM. Filling with the LEAGUE value and merely RE-TUNING the shrinkage strength already gives +0.61 / +0.86 / +1.20 / +0.32. RAPM's marginal contribution over that is +0.43pp points, +0.10pp attempts, +0.13pp minutes, +0.06pp ppm. The negative control -- the SAME map fed RELABELLED RAPM -- itself reaches +0.73pp points, so even the points figure is only about +0.31pp clear of its own null.
step3_rapm_as_reference.the_users_question_answered_directly: F2 replaces the RAPM fill with the player's RAW previous-season box score from master_player, which has the SAME backward coverage (both reach 2021) and is the same season-level object but carries NO opponent or teammate adjustment. It scores +0.63 / +0.85 / +1.06 / +0.45 -- indistinguishable from RAPM on attempts, minutes and ppm, and BETTER than RAPM on ppm. The ADJUSTMENT buys almost nothing over the raw box score; only on points does RAPM lead, by ~0.4pp.

mechanism.note: Only 688 of the 2,147 rows the fill touches have a real RAPM value; the other 1,459 receive a season-mean-imputed RAPM, which the map turns into something close to the league constant. That is why F1 sits so close to F0.

step4_coldstart.verdict: SPLIT. For VETERANS RETURNING, RAPM genuinely beats D092's placeholder. For TRUE ROOKIES it does not exist, and using it is actively harmful.
step4_coldstart.tier: D092's tier_poor (fewer than 3 prior same-season appearances), seasons 2023-2024 only, n=698
step4_coldstart.why_2022_excluded: The RAPM->level map must be fitted on seasons strictly earlier than the scored season and 2022 has no earlier season inside the frame. This step therefore covers a SUBSET of D092's rows and its numbers are NOT directly comparable to D092's three-season headline. The incumbent is rescored on exactly these rows.
step4_coldstart.population_split_agreement: The two independent markers (a RAPM value exists; pl_prior_season_games > 0) agree on ALL 698 rows -- 572 veteran-returning, 126 true rookie, 0 ambiguous.
step4_coldstart.the_clean_result: On VETERANS RETURNING, C3 (D092's structural prior plus a walk-forward-fitted RAPM term) beats D092 by +2.28% on points (p=0.0015) and +1.03% on minutes, while the SAME construction with the RAPM term removed gives +1.11% and -0.45%, and the negative control with relabelled RAPM gives +0.77% and -0.44%. RAPM's own contribution is therefore about +1.2pp on points and +1.5pp on minutes, clear of its own null.
step4_coldstart.the_rookie_result: On TRUE ROOKIES, C3 with RAPM (+2.76% points, +8.14% minutes) is much WORSE than the same construction without RAPM (+8.31%, +10.53%). Replacing D092's prior with RAPM outright (C1/C4) costs -54% on points and -51% on minutes. RAPM has nothing to say about a player with no prior-season possessions, and the imputed value destroys the draft-slot signal D092 correctly relies on.
step4_coldstart.note_on_prereg: C1 and C4 as preregistered turned out to be the SAME construction. Both are reported; the identity is a property of the preregistered list, not a result, and nothing was dropped.

step5_raw_plusminus.verdict: CLEAN NULL. Raw per-game plus-minus adds nothing, over the base or over base+RAPM, on any target, on either stratum.
step5_raw_plusminus.head_to_head: RAPM's dR2 over base+plus-minus is essentially identical to its dR2 over base alone (points +0.00261 vs +0.00258), while plus-minus's dR2 over base+RAPM is +0.00025 and inside its null. RAPM survives plus-minus; plus-minus does not survive RAPM. Neither is large.
step5_raw_plusminus.within_season_form_hypothesis: The motivation for testing it -- that a game-level series could carry within-season form that a season-level RAPM structurally cannot -- is NOT supported. The game-level family (P01-P04) is as null as the season-level one.
step5_raw_plusminus.null_used: CYCLIC SHIFT within (season, player) for the game-level family (credit D093, E1_I0021); PLAYER-SEASON RELABELLING for pm_prev_season, which is constant within a player-season. Never a within-player shuffle.

controls.negative_control: Whole-player-season relabelling of the RAPM block. Run in step 2 (dR2), in the step-3 fill decomposition (F4) and in the step-4 C3 decomposition. It is NOT near zero in step 2 -- it reproduces 40-50% of the pooled dR2 -- and that is exactly why every claim here is measured against the permutation null rather than against zero.
controls.noop_placebo: RAPM block multiplied by 1.0: VERIFIED to change 0 of 138,790 cells and to reproduce the real dR2 to machine precision for all four targets.
controls.perturbed_placebo: RAPM block + 1e-6*sd: VERIFIED to change all 138,790 cells, so the placebo machinery is demonstrably live rather than silently inert.

denominator_rule_D099: Every dR2 in every output table carries an `sst_basis` column and is reported BOTH on its own stratum's SST and on the full wf_eval SST (or, in step 4, the full data-poor-tier SST). No subset dR2 is compared to a full-stratum dR2 anywhere.
what_would_change_the_answer: A RAPM built at a finer as-of granularity than the season. Every limitation above traces to it being one number per player per season; the cold-start veteran result is the only place a season-level prior is the right shape for the problem.

A frame that reaches back to 2021 as scored rows. 22.6% of walk-forward rows have no prior-season mean IN THE FRAME, and that gap -- not RAPM's adjustment -- is most of what the step-3 fill is repairing.

More seasons. The 2023 fold is trained on 2022 alone, the first season in the frame, where no prior-season quantity exists at all; and the 2022 RAPM fit itself is maximally shrunk with thin_history_caveat=True.
